Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Testing

- [ ] `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug`

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no signing secrets, APKs, IDE state, or personal test images

- [ ] Documentation or tests were updated where needed
